results.process_step: CMP (post-PM pad break-in on CMP-04) - copper/oxide polish
results.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP remaining-film thickness / removal-rate radial profile on this lot vs. a pre-PM lot: a sharp edge roll-off (over- or under-polish in the outer 5-10 mm) confirms CMP edge non-uniformity from the new pad, whereas a flat radial profile with the same edge fails would point to a litho/etch or edge-bead-removal origin

results.process_step: Post-CMP / coat-develop edge bead removal and wafer edge film integrity; check CMP edge removal rate at CMP-04
results.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP thickness/removal profile radially: if the outer 3-5 mm shows over-polish (edge roll-off) the cause is CMP edge over-removal after the new pad break-in; if edge film is intact and the failures instead follow the coater EBR cut line (sharp radius boundary matching EBR width), it is edge bead removal.

results.pattern_name: edge ring with random center-clustered scatter defects
results.discriminating_check: Defect review of the scattered center failures: if SEM/inline inspection shows embedded pad fragments or slurry-agglomerate scratches (arc/curved micro-scratches) concentrated in the wafer interior, and the defect density decays on subsequent wafers as the new pad breaks in, cmp_pad_debris is confirmed; purely electrical opens with no visible particles/scratches would rule it out.

results.pattern_name: full-perimeter edge ring (1-2 die wide) with light random background speckle
results.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) post-PM pad break-in polish of this layer
results.discriminating_check: Measure post-CMP remaining-film/step-height radial profile: if the outer 3-5 mm shows significant over-polish (edge thinning / excess removal) versus center on this lot but not on pre-PM lots, CMP edge over-polish from the fresh pad is confirmed; a flat radial removal profile with the ring instead tracking a coat/etch edge exclusion boundary would rule it out and point to EBR/bevel etch or film edge rolloff.

results.pattern_name: partial edge ring (bottom/left arc) with random background defects
results.process_step: CMP (CMP-04) post-PM pad break-in / polish uniformity
results.discriminating_check: Inspect post-CMP wafer for edge-region residual film thickness or scratch/debris signature (bright-field scratch map) on the bottom-left arc; if edge thickness is off-target/over-polished on that arc and the same arc appears on other wafers from the same head/carrier, CMP post-PM pad break-in is confirmed. Absence of CMP scratches/thickness excursion at that arc would rule it out and point to an edge-bead/bevel or clamp issue.
